model_output.verdict: A construction project manager with project values, trade counts and delivery results a recruiter can quickly grasp.
write_up: This is a strong construction project management resume: you show the projects you run at Capitol Builders and the results you've delivered! A recruiter can see both tenant-improvement and ground-up retail work without guessing how big the jobs are.

The $14M grocery store line is the standout. It names the build, its value and the schedule result. Your move from assistant project manager to project manager is easy to follow, and Experience sits where it should, above Education.

Let's add what you did to keep change orders down. For a more senior role, you can also show a decision you made across projects, if you have one to share. Your resume isn't likely to be the thing holding you back; the competition and the match between your projects and the job will matter too.
